title: Fetch the top 5 Hacker News stories and save them as JSON
description: Use the Hacker News Firebase API (https://hacker-news.firebaseio.com/v0/topstories.json). Fetch the top 5 stories, keep title, url and score, write them to hn-top5.json, then print the file.

title: Report the sandbox's kernel and tooling
description: Run uname -a, node -v, git --version and df -h /. Write a short markdown report to vm-report.md and print it.

title: Stand up an HTTP health check and prove it responds
description: Create a minimal Node HTTP server in server.mjs on port 3000 with GET /health returning {"ok":true}. Start it in the background and curl it to prove it works.

title: Write a haiku about trains to a file and read it back
description: Compose a haiku about trains, write it to haiku.txt, then print the file to check it landed.

title: Benchmark JSON.parse on a 10 MB payload
description: Write bench.mjs that generates about 10 MB of JSON, parses it 10 times, and reports the average milliseconds per parse. Run it and report the number.
